title: MMHeatmap
description: A heatmap plugin built on top of dynmap
body:
A heatmap built on top of dynmap. Uses dynmap markers on layers so players can click on cells to examine player activity over a set time period. Each layer includes multiple settings. Config includes color options, database options, and player action weights for a fully customizable heatmap!

(NOTE: Documentation is using github [here](https://github.com/Bryson-C/MMHeatmap/tree/main) rather than in game because images better explain the functionality, also brigadier is hard to work with and look at)
